requirement_text.REQ-455:
Approved by the user on 2026-10-06. Process design gaps are found late,
in UAT: 35 files under docs/issues/ mention a dead end, an unreachable
step or a missing default route (recent: ISS-0928 no_matching_edge on a
service task in kyc-routing, ISS-0929). Letflow.Definitions.Graph
already checks a good deal (violation codes at
lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex:207-234: missing start or end node,
dangling edge, isolated node, cycle without gateway, missing role,
missing edge condition, multiple default edges,
human_task_no_fallback_edge and more). This entry adds only what is
missing, as deterministic checks that run wherever the existing ones
run, so they do not depend on any model.

FIRST STEP (CODE-DESIGNER): for each candidate check below, establish
by reading graph.ex, semantic_validation.ex and their tests whether it
already exists, exists partly, or is missing, and record the finding
with file and line. Build only the missing part.

CANDIDATE CHECKS:
1. Reachability: every node is reachable from the start node, and from
every node at least one end node is reachable. (check_isolated_nodes
looks at a node's own edges; establish whether a connected island or a
trap with no way out is caught.)
2. Decision without a default route: an exclusive gateway, and any
other node kind whose outgoing edges all carry conditions (ISS-0928
was a service task), has no is_default edge, so an instance can stop
with no matching route. Establish which node kinds can have
conditional outgoing edges and cover all of them.
3. Data used before it is collected: an edge condition or form
expression reads a variable that no form, service output or
sub-process output on ANY path from the start to that point can have
set. Reuse the declared-fields machinery of SemanticValidation; report
only the case where no path sets it (certain), not the case where some
path does not (that is a judgment for PROCESS-AUDITOR, REQ-456).
4. Unbound task roles at install: when a definition or solution pack is
installed or activated in a tenant, every role a human task routes to
that has no tenant_role binding in that tenant is listed. Decision
0029 section 2 keeps required roles advisory and role seeding out of
packs; do not change that. This is a reported warning in the
validation result and the install response, never a silent pass and
never an automatic binding.
New findings in 1 to 3 are violations (activation is refused, same as
the existing codes). State in the design whether any definition
shipped in priv/ or seeded by scripts/ fails a new check; if one does,
report it to ORCH as an issue with the definition and node named, and
do not weaken the check.
OPEN QUESTIONS: - "A definition already active in a tenant that fails a new check keeps running. Default: new checks apply at validate, activate and import time only; nothing is deactivated."
